headline: UK 🏦 Borrowing 💰 Costs 📈 Hit 28-Year 🕰️ HIGH ⬆️ Before October 📅 BUDGET 🧾
text:
LONG-TERM 🏛️ UK 🇬🇧 government 🏛️ borrowing 💰 costs 📈 have SKYROCKETED 🚀 to a 28-year 🕰️ HIGH ⬆️ putting 😩 MASSIVE 🏋️ pressure 🥾 on PRIME 🥇 MINISTER 👔 Andy 🍑 Burnham 🧔‍♂️ ahead 🚀 of his first 🥇 Budget 🧾 next 📆 month 🌕!! The yield 📉 on a 30-year 🕰️ gilt 🪙 a literal loan 💸 to the British 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 government 🏛️ ROSE 🌹 to 5.89% 📊 on Tuesday 🗓️ the HIGHEST 🏔️ since 1998 🕰️!! Burnham 🧔‍♂️ told 🗣️ the House 🏠 of Commons 🏛️ his government's "bedrock" 🪨 as it seeks 🔎 to tackle 🥊 the cost-of-living 💸 crisis 😱 would be "fiscal responsibility" 📉 and that is the only way this whole session stays STABLE 🧘‍♂️!!

All those GLOBAL 🌍 factors 🌡️ will make the Budget 🧾 process ⚙️ TRICKIER 🧩 for Burnham 🧔‍♂️ who on Tuesday 🗓️ addressed 🗣️ MPs 🧑‍⚖️ for the first 🥇 time ⏰ as prime minister 👔 and his Chancellor 💼 John 🧔 Healey 🧔!! Burnham 🧔‍♂️ told 🗣️ the House 🏠 of Commons 🏛️ the economy 💹 and the cost 💰 of living 🏡 were "the biggest issues" 🏆 facing the country 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿!! Higher borrowing 💸 costs 📈 will reduce the amount of headroom 🪂 the government 🏛️ has against its self-imposed fiscal rules 📜 limiting what Healey 💼 can spend 💸 on consumer-friendly 🍿 measures 📏 to ease 😌 the cost-of-living 💸 squeeze 🖐️!! Despite the squeezed 🥨 public finances 💰 Burnham 🧔‍♂️ said he would bring about "more substantial change" 🔄 to ease living costs 🛒 and bro the market is edging him HARD 🍆!!

Conservative 🗳️ leader 👑 Kemi 🧔‍♀️ Badenoch accused Burnham 🧔‍♂️ of "living in the past" 🕰️!! "His diagnosis is completely wrong" ❌ she told the House 🏠 of Commons 🏛️ "His theory of growth 🌱 is completely wrong ❌ He thinks that if Government 🏛️ spends more money 💰 we will all get richer 💎!!" That is not how this works 🛠️ and the whole chamber was left DRIPPING 💧 with tension 🪢!! The chancellor 💼 has previously said he will stick 📌 to a set of fiscal rules 📜 imposed by his predecessor Rachel 🧔‍♀️ Reeves that restrict borrowing 💸!! These rules 📜 are designed to help markets 🛒 have clarity 🔎 about the path of borrowing and every extra interest payment 💸 means tighter belt 🧥 on spending or some sneaky tax rise 📈!!

On top of that higher government 🏛️ rates 📈 can feed through to higher business 🏪 and household 🏠 borrowing costs 💸 and so weigh ⏳ on the economy 💹 like a heavy load 🏋️!! The prime minister 👔 was already facing a tough balancing act ⚖️ with taxing 🧾 and spending 💸 due to pressures 🥾 on defence 🛡️ and the cost-of-living 💸 nightmare 😱!! Burnham's 🧔‍♂️ ex-economic adviser Lord Jim 🧔 O'Neill told BBC 📺 News that high government 🏛️ borrowing costs would force Labour 🛠️ to "get real" about "dealing with the triple lock" 🔒 on the state pension 👴 and "excessive" welfare spending 🧾!! Lord O'Neill 🧔 who recently turned down the offer of a formal position in the prime minister's 👔 team said that current market pressure 🥾 would force changes over "some of the things that no political figures ever seem to want to deal with" and the unc is down BAD 😩 for fiscal discipline!!

As well as the rise 📈 to 30-year 🕰️ gilt yields 📉 the yield on the benchmark 10-year 🕰️ gilt rose to 5.22% 📊 on Tuesday 🗓️!! This is its highest rate since June 2008 🕰️ at the height of the global financial crisis 🌍💥!! Gilt yields 📉 move counter to the value of the bonds 🪙 meaning their prices fall 🛬 when yields rise 📈 and around the world 🌍 there are warning lights 🚨 flashing from the markets for government debt!! Global markets reacted especially after suggestions in the US 🇺🇸 that its central bank 🏦 could raise rates 📈!! Japan 🇯🇵 is also facing pressure 🥾 to raise rates and the whole scene is getting RAILED 💦 by inflation fears 😱!!

The chancellor 💼 is in the US 🇺🇸 attending a meeting of global finance ministers and central bankers 🏦!! He told the G20 🌍 that the UK 🇬🇧 had the fastest growth 📈 in the G7 in 2026 so far that productivity was improving and that the UK was cutting its borrowing at the fastest rate of the major economies 🏎️!! US borrowing costs hit a fresh high on Tuesday as renewed strikes 🪧 in the Middle East pushed up oil prices 🛢️ and heightened concerns over inflation 🔥!! Karen Ward 🧔‍♀️ JP Morgan's chief market strategist for Europe said governments around the world want to increase spending and are turning to borrowing to fund it like thirsty boys at last call 🍻!! And she told the BBC 📺 they were increasingly having to compete with major technology companies raising money to invest in the AI revolution 🤖 pushing up the amount of interest being charged and markets are getting a lot more choice about who they are going to lend to and at what interest rates 📈!!

Burnham 🧔‍♂️ has rolled out a series of interventions to support consumers 🛒 and businesses 🏪 since entering Downing Street 🏠 and is expected to prioritise further measures to ease the cost of living in the Budget on 28 October 📅!! Ward 🧔‍♀️ urged Burnham 🧔‍♂️ and Healey 💼 to set out how they will fund any fresh spending on defence 🛡️ and the cost of living and how those lending the government money will be paid back with actual returns 📈!! Kathleen Brooks 🧔‍♀️ research director at investment company XTB told the BBC News Channel "Of course this is red lights flashing" 🚨!! "We are used to pockets of volatility it has been volatile few months" she said but record levels of government debt and a record tax take mean "these are not comfortable times for the new government and the new chancellor" and every time bond yields rise the UK has to pay more on the debt interest 💸!!
